tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit with normal MCV and MCH). Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and platelet distribution width are elevated, suggesting increased platelet turnover or activation. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further evaluation of anemia and platelet morphology is recommended.
